title: RRB NTPC CBT 1 Result 2026 Out, Graduate Merit List PDF Zone Wise, Scorecard Link
fullContentHtml:
The Railway Recruitment Board has released the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Graduate Result 2026 on 11th June at the official website https://www.rrbcdg.gov.in/ or other regional websites. All the candidates who have appeared for the NTPC Graduate Exams (CEN 06/2025) conducted from 16th March to 27th March can now check or download their scorecard, merit list. In order to download the RRB NTPC Result, candidates need to login using the Registration Number and Date of Birth. Scroll down to get complete information related to the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Graduate Result 2026.

RRB NTPC CBT 1 Result 2026 Out 

As the Railway Recruitment Board successfully conducted the RRB NTPC Graduate CBT 1 Exam from 16th March to 27th March, candidates who appeared for the exam had been eagerly awaiting their results. Now, the RRB NTPC Result 2026 has finally been released. Along with the result, the Railway Recruitment Board has also uploaded the NTPC CBT 1 Cut Off Marks and zone-wise merit list PDFs. The RRB NTPC CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 has been uploaded on 12th June 2026 on the official candidate login portal rrb.digialm.com. All the candidates who got cleared the CBT 1 Stage, are now provisionally selected for the next stage, that is Stage 2.

Steps to Download RRB NTPC CBT 1 Result 2026

The RRB NTPC result is updated on the regional websites of the RRB. To download the RRB NTPC CBT 1 result, candidates have to follow a very simple process.

Step 1: Visit the official website of the Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) or the respective regional RRB website.

Step 2: Locate the link for “RRB NTPC Graduate Result/ Scorecard CEN 06/2025” on the homepage.

Step 3: Click on the relevant result link provided.

Step 4: Download the result PDF file displayed on the screen.

Step 5: Search for their registration number in the PDF using the Ctrl + F.

Step 6: Check the scorecard by logging in with their registration number and date of birth.

Step 7: Download or print the result for future reference.

RRB NTPC CBT 1 Graduate Scorecard 2026

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Graduate Scorecard 2026 along with the CBT 1 result on 12th June 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination conducted can download their scorecards by entering their Registration Number and Date of Birth. The scorecard provides detailed information about the candidate’s performance, including raw marks, normalized marks, section-wise scores, qualifying status, and category-wise cut-off details. What Next After RRB NTPC CBT 1 Graduate Result?

After the release of the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Result, candidates will be called for the next round i.e. CBT 2. Those who clear the RRB NTPC CBT 2 Exam will be shortlisted for the next stage, i.e., CBAT. Candidates need to qualify all the stages to appear for Document Verification & Medical Examination. Finally, after clearing all the stages of the selection process, the Railway Recruitment Board will prepare the merit list and allot posts and zones to candidates as per their rank, merit, and preference.

RRB NTPC Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the RRB NTPC Result 2026 released?

Ans: Yes, the Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) released the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Graduate Result 2026 on 11th June for CEN 06/2025. Candidates can check their qualifying status, merit list, and scorecard through the respective regional RRB websites.

Q2. How can I download the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Scorecard 2026?

Ans: Candidates can download the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 by visiting the official RRB website, clicking on the scorecard link, and logging in using their Registration Number and Date of Birth. The scorecard contains marks obtained, normalized score, qualifying status, and category details.

Q3. What is the next stage after qualifying the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Exam 2026?

Ans: Candidates who qualify the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Exam 2026 will be shortlisted for the CBT 2 examination. Depending on the post applied for, candidates may further appear for CBAT, CBTST, Document Verification, and Medical Examination before final selection.

Q4. Are the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Cut Off Marks 2026 released?

Ans: Yes, the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Cut Off Marks 2026 have been released along with the result. The cut-off marks vary according to region, category, exam difficulty level, number of vacancies, and the total number of candidates who appeared for the examination.

Q5. What is the marking scheme of the NTPC 2026 Graduate-Level exam?

Ans: The NTPC marking scheme for both UG and Graduate levels is the same. A penalty of 1/3 mark for every wrong answer, with +1 mark awarded for correct answers
